subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The elephant remains the central subject across all shots, with plausible changes in distance, angle, and framing. Appearance varies somewhat in tusk size, skin tone, and proximity, but not enough to clearly indicate a different animal.

background_coherent.rationale: The savanna setting, acacia trees, golden grass, distant hills, and safari-vehicle interior framing remain consistent across the sequence. Human observers and camera gear appear only in the shots whose captions call for them.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the safari-vehicle view, golden savanna, acacia trees, and a lone elephant moving left to right.
Matches the filmmaker, camera rig, vehicle framing, and distant elephant; the human is somewhat cropped but recognizable.

Close elephant view with vehicle bars is consistent, though the caption's upward low-angle motion cannot be verified from the single frame.
Close facial view fits the elephant portrait and vehicle-frame invariant, but the frame includes more foreground obstruction than the caption emphasizes.
Matches a frontal elephant approach in the same savanna vehicle perspective.

which_cut_broke.how: No single cut clearly breaks consistency; the largest shift is from shot 2 to shot 3, where the elephant jumps from medium-distance savanna framing to an extreme close-up, but this is plausible as a camera/framing change.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not copied or frozen; they show distinct shot compositions, subject scale changes, added human/camera elements when requested, and continued adherence to the safari-vehicle invariant.
